title: The Cryo-Pension Transit
logline: A technician discovers an orbital cold-sleep hospice is under-powering retired miners' cryogenic pods to siphon electrical coolant to private luxury berths.

roles.description: Works maintenance on seventy cryogenic sleeper pods; gentle, overworked, horrified by telemetry anomalies.
Head of the long-term retiree preservation facility; smooth, pragmatic, rationalizing cold-sleep cuts as necessary austerity.
The fraternal charity funding the cryogenic preservation of retired frontier miners.
The private orbital yacht club purchasing diverted coolant to chill luxury observation salons.
A refrigerated orbital spire housing two hundred retired labourers in suspended animation.
The private pleasure dock where wealthy seasonal visitors moor their climate-controlled ships.
The miners' fraternal assembly hall where benefit accounts and memorial records are kept.

public_situation: {role:miners_fellowship} holds an annual vigil for sleeping retirees at {role:cryo_mausoleum} while the facility reports rising maintenance surcharges.
private_truth: {role:vault_director} has been throttling the pod temperature regulators to seventy percent efficiency, selling the diverted fluorocarbon coolant to {role:luxury_consortium} to pocket the markup.

beats.public_change: Mausoleum staff post visitor restrictions around the lower preservation vaults, citing routine heat-pump maintenance.

missions.reason: She needs an outside pilot to scan the exterior pod heat-exchange manifolds and document the unexplained temperature drift before the director resets the monitors.
missions.private_fact: Her own grandmother is sleeping in pod thirty-four and has shown fluctuating cellular telemetry for three weeks.

beats.public_change: Temperature alarms ring quietly in the lower stacks while yacht berths across the station report abundant supercooled fluid deliveries.

missions.reason: She asks the pilot to purchase medical-grade liquid nitrogen at the station exchange and deliver it directly to the auxiliary chiller loop.
missions.private_fact: She emptied her personal savings account to pay for the coolant without filing an official requisition.

beats.public_change: The fellowship executive board gathers at {role:charity_hall} to review the mausoleum's annual endowment renewal.

missions.reason: She needs the exported temperature logs and coolant sales receipts delivered to the miners fellowship board before the director purges the local server.
missions.private_fact: The director offered to restore her grandmother's pod to full maximum power if she destroys the log drives.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the telemetry evidence outside the fraternal boardroom while the director's lawyers wait.

options.label: Deliver the telemetry to the miners fellowship to force municipal prosecution
Sell the log drives to the director to keep the luxury contracts quiet
Force the luxury yacht club to subsidize the mausoleum in exchange for silence

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the temperature evidence to the fellowship board.
resolutions.summary: The telemetry is tabled before the fellowship. {role:vault_director} is arrested for reckless endangerment, luxury contracts are cancelled, and full chilling power is restored.

consequences.public_summary: Miners honor a pilot who exposed how station doctors siphoned coolant off sleeping retirees to chill champagne for yachts.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the director's payoff and withholds the logs.
resolutions.summary: The logs are destroyed. {role:vault_director} expands coolant sales to luxury berths, and several sleeping retirees suffer irreversible cellular decay.

consequences.public_summary: Dock rumors claim a pilot took luxury credits to bury evidence that old miners were slowly thawing in their pods.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot forces a quiet corporate endowment settlement.
resolutions.summary: A settlement is signed. {role:luxury_consortium} pays a heavy annual surcharge directly to {role:miners_fellowship} to upgrade the chillers, keeping the scandal private.

resolutions.reached_by: Telemetry scans fail or the courier run is abandoned.
resolutions.summary: The technician's complaints are dismissed as calibration drift. {role:vault_director} continues diverting coolant, and the sleeper pods slowly degrade unnoticed.

loose_threads.detail: The sealed coolant drums at the yacht basin bear medical-grade sterilization stamps reserved for hospital suspension vats.
The miners fraternal board posted a twenty percent dividend cut to cover unexplained cryogenic maintenance expenses.
A luxury yacht basin ordinance grants unmonitored utility priority to private berths during peak holiday seasons.

radio_hooks: Miners fraternal association marks annual memorial day for pioneers preserved in deep sleep.
Luxury yacht basin managers announce complete upgrade of private climate-control loops.
Station utilities board reports peak seasonal power demand across residential and recreation sectors.

voice_direction.hospice_technician: Soft-spoken, hesitant, and visibly anxious. Speaks in careful technical figures and pauses nervously before mentioning hospital directors.
voice_direction.vault_director: Warm, measured, and soothing. Frames life-threatening maintenance cuts as unavoidable thermodynamic realities and smiles through difficult questions.
